objective: Apply the findings the user picked from a model-upgrade audit, and update hard-coded model references from an approved mapping table. Copy this template: add one X<n>-<FINDING-ID> task per picked finding (the id must stay path-safe: letters, digits, dot, dash, underscore) (use agentRole refactorer when the finding is overengineering and behaviour must not change, worker otherwise), fill <scope> with the files the finding names, <test-command> with the project's real verification suite, and <mapping-table> with the old→new model reference pairs the user approved (the lead builds that table itself with the fixed grep patterns in the aorch-model-upgrade skill; inventory is reconnaissance and is not delegated). Reinstalling the .aorch copies after this plan is one command the lead runs, not a task. Every write task here carries verificationCommands, so this is the plan that records the new model's first routing observations.

tasks.title: Close one picked finding
tasks.objective: Implement the proposal of finding <finding-id> from the audit receipt at <audit-receipt-path>, inside <scope> only. Make the smallest defensible change, run the named verification fresh, and never weaken, skip, or rewrite a test to make it pass. Anything the proposal implies beyond <scope> goes to unresolvedRisks.
acceptanceCriteria: The proposal of finding <finding-id> is applied or its blocker is reported in unresolvedRisks.
The named verification suite passes unmodified.

tasks.title: Update model references per the approved mapping table
tasks.objective: Replace model identifiers only where <mapping-table> lists an old→new pair, in the files it names: <mapping-files>. Do not touch a reference that is not in the table — list it in unresolvedRisks with its path instead. Preserve surrounding formatting (frontmatter, JSON, TOML). Run the named verification fresh.
acceptanceCriteria: Every pair in the mapping table is applied and every out-of-table reference is reported, not changed.
The named verification suite passes unmodified.
